title: Average duration of first-instance civil proceedings, Valmarina district, 2019-2024
bodyMd: The chart shows, for each year from 2019 to 2024, the average duration in months of a civil proceeding at first instance in the Valmarina district.

data.caption: Average duration in months of a first-instance civil proceeding in the Valmarina district in each year from 2019 to 2024.

accessibilityText: A bar chart with one bar per year from 2019 to 2024, showing the average duration in months of a first-instance civil proceeding. The values are: 2019, 30 months; 2020, 36 months; 2021, 33 months; 2022, 27 months; 2023, 24 months; 2024, 18 months. The series rises once, from 30 months in 2019 to a peak of 36 months in 2020, and then falls in every subsequent year to its lowest value, 18 months, in 2024.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional judicial district. Values were chosen as multiples of three so that every year-on-year percentage change can be computed mentally without a calculator.
